notes: PADS REMAP + AUTO-CONNECT + the last hairs of latency. Every drum pad is now REMAPPABLE: tap Remap on the Pads page, tap a pad, press any key — done (Reset map restores the standard layout; crash defaults to any black key). Your MIDI keyboard now AUTO-CONNECTS on every launch and after every update — enable it once and the LUMI is just there, colors synced. Latency shaved further: the audio engine now requests the tightest buffer the hardware allows, sample lead-trim cuts closer, and note attacks are snappier. SETTINGS: updates never clear them (they live on this device) — new Backup card in Settings exports/imports everything (preferences, palettes, jam songs, studio tracks) so you can move between installs; if settings ever 'reset', you were likely in a different browser profile.
